Chapter 14: Living in Light of God’s Majesty.
You know, what we believe about God isn’t just something to keep tucked away in our heads or left sitting on a dusty shelf. It’s meant to shape every corner of our lives—our work, our relationships, even our hopes and decisions. Living in light of God’s majesty changes the way we see everything. It gives us courage. It fills us with hope.
Imagine waking up to a brand new day. The sunlight’s pouring in through your window, and there’s this quiet sense of possibility. That deep-down confidence comes from knowing your entire life is held in hands much bigger than your own.
Most people don’t realize just how much their picture of God shapes the day-to-day choices they make. If you truly see God as both great and good, you’ll find yourself living with open hands—and an open heart. Suddenly, there’s freedom. Freedom to take risks. Freedom to love. Freedom to serve others.
Let me share a story. There was a volunteer who spent years feeling like she didn’t really matter. But then, she started to realize that every single act of kindness had value. With a fresh sense of God’s greatness, even her ordinary tasks felt meaningful. And on tough days, she found new strength she never knew she had.
What really stood out? Living in light of God’s majesty isn’t about getting everything perfect. It’s about your perspective. It’s about seeing every single moment as a chance to reflect God’s character, and looking at every challenge as an opportunity to trust Him just a little bit more.
Now, maybe you’ve felt like it’s hard to connect your faith with your daily life. Maybe God seems distant from the little details. But the real story of faith? It’s about a God who’s right here—present, involved, and genuinely interested in every part of your life.
